# What GitHub credentials the library redacts, and what it leaves alone.
#
# Every token here is built from the ordered run 0123456789abcdef, which no real
# credential is.

patterns: github-token

# The kinds of token that carry a prefix. GitHub documents the prefixes but no
# length, so each kind is stated once rather than being assumed to follow from
# another.

case: a personal access token in an environment assignment
in:   GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  GITHUB_TOKEN=«github-token»

case: an oauth app access token on its own
in:   gho_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  «github-token»

case: a github app user access token
in:   ghu_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  «github-token»

case: an installation access token in its classic form
in:   ghs_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  «github-token»

case: a refresh token
in:   ghr_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  «github-token»

case: a fine grained personal access token
in:   github_pat_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789
out:  «github-token»

# The lengths either side of what each kind must reach. GitHub gives no length,
# so what the library accepts is the shortest body it has seen, and the pair of
# cases below is where that choice is written down.

case: a classic body of thirty-six characters is a token
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  «github-token»

case: a classic body of thirty-five characters is not
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxy
out:  ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxy

case: a classic body longer than thirty-six characters is redacted whole
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789
out:  «github-token»

case: a fine grained body of eighty-two characters is a token
in:   github_pat_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789
out:  «github-token»

case: a fine grained body of eighty-one characters is not
in:   github_pat_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz012345678
out:  github_pat_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz012345678

# The stateless installation token, which carries a JWT after the app id.

case: a stateless installation token
in:   ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «github-token»

case: a stateless installation token with a long app id
in:   ghs_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «github-token»

case: an app id as long as a whole classic token body
in:   ghs_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0123456789abcdef
out:  «github-token»

case: a stateless installation token cut before its signature is not redacted
in:   ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ
out:  ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ

case: one character of signature is enough for the whole token
in:   ghs_123456_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.0
out:  «github-token»

case: an app id followed by something that is not a jwt
in:   ghs_123456_0123456789abcdef.0123456789.0123456789
out:  ghs_123456_0123456789abcdef.0123456789.0123456789

case: a classic token followed by a file name is not drawn into one span
in:   ghs_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_backup.tar.gz
out:  «github-token»_backup.tar.gz

# Where a token sits.

case: a token in a json body
in:   {"token":"ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz","scope":"repo"}
out:  {"token":"«github-token»","scope":"repo"}

case: a token in an authorization header
in:   Authorization: token ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  Authorization: token «github-token»

case: a token exported by a shell
in:   export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
out:  export GITHUB_TOKEN="«github-token»"

case: a token in a clone url
in:   git clone https://x-access-token:ghs_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz@github.com/koki-develop/mask-go.git
out:  git clone https://x-access-token:«github-token»@github.com/koki-develop/mask-go.git

case: a token run together with the word before it
in:   TOKEN_ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  TOKEN_«github-token»

case: a token ending a sentence keeps the full stop
in:   the token is ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz.
out:  the token is «github-token».

case: two tokens on one line
in:   old=ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz new=gho_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  old=«github-token» new=«github-token»

case: a classic token and a fine grained one
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz github_pat_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789
out:  «github-token» «github-token»

case: a token at the very start and another at the very end
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz in between gho_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  «github-token» in between «github-token»

# What is not a token.

case: prose mentioning a ghost
in:   the ghost of a token haunts this line
out:  the ghost of a token haunts this line

case: a prefix with no body
in:   ghp_
out:  ghp_

case: a prefix naming no kind of token
in:   ghx_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  ghx_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz

case: a prefix written with a hyphen
in:   ghp-0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  ghp-0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz

case: a prefix missing its kind
in:   gh_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  gh_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz

case: a prefix in capitals
in:   GHP_0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ
out:  GHP_0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ

case: a body broken by a hyphen
in:   ghp_0123456789abcdef-ghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456
out:  ghp_0123456789abcdef-ghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456

case: an environment assignment with nothing after it
in:   GITHUB_TOKEN=
out:  GITHUB_TOKEN=

case: a git command line
in:   git push origin main --force-with-lease
out:  git push origin main --force-with-lease

case: a fine grained prefix with a classic length body
in:   github_pat_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
out:  github_pat_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
